title: Cursor verify config
description: Defines the quality gates the agent must pass before delivering an iteration.

onlyRunWhenDirty.description: If true, checks only run when the git working tree has uncommitted changes. Skips heavy runs on pure Q&A turns.

failClosed.description: If true, a crashing/timing-out verify hook blocks completion. If false, it fails open.

maxOutputChars.description: Max characters of failing-command output injected back into the agent context.

command.description: Shell command to run. Empty string is treated as not configured.
